d: Wardens step into the world of CSI this week in determining where a deer was killed; when uncovering the truth, the best thing is to follow the blood trail.
The illegal killing of multiple animals over the past five years by a family of poachers is going to trial; wardens on the witness stand hope for a guilty verdict and a closed case.
The wardens search a house where four pit-bulls guard a safe.
Three wardens act on a report of a large alligator who has taken up residence in a lake recreation area.
A warden's K-9 tracker bites a suspected marijuana grower; wardens track a pig poacher; surveillance on a woman suspected of feeding bears.
The guys have more questions than answers and find an abandoned trappers cabin.

On day three of the river movement, a hunting camp is desperately needed to boost morale of the crew; in pursuit of downing a giant bull; frustration boils over as the brothers admit for the first time they aren't sure what to do.
Casey gets into position with his bow; as the second bull makes his way up river toward the dead bull, Casey moves down to the river's edge for a closer look; the bull and Casey have a stand-off.
After killing a bull moose, Chris and Casey cut it up and make a meat cache to preserve rations.
Sonia and Froy show their best dance moves; Matt and Sonia meet a vindictive boyfriend; Lou and Froy match up against a gang of vicious roadies.
Matt and Froy's voluntary repo comes with a surprise; the owner of the target car is struck by an apparent heart attack; a repo becomes violent.
Sonia and Lou are in the middle of nowhere with a trio of nerdy stargazers; Lou and Matt are caught in the middle of a police sting operation.
Froy and Sonia are overwhelmed by a swarm of cheerleaders; Matt and Froy interrupt a father and son bonding session gone wrong; the team heads to the raceway to prove they still have what it takes.
Lou and Froy repo an airplane; Matt and Sonia take a repo from a pole dancing studio.
Mike goes to Two Bit Circus to learn about disruptive innovation and how to get kids curious about how things work again.
Mike visits Caltrans to explore the massive undertaking of maintaining California's roads and highways, from repairing damaged infrastructure to ensuring safety for millions of drivers.

Join Mike and his team as they dive into the inner workings of the USS John Stennis, the largest ship in the U.S. Navy; from the bustling mess hall to the action-packed flight deck, Mike takes on every job on board.

Mike continues his tour aboard the USS John C. Stennis to look at the on-board entertainment and meal regime; he takes a leisurely stroll on deck to search for dangerous ball bearings and camera equipment.
Small, lightweight cars, like vintage Hondas, prove fun isn't limited by size.
In 1957, car styling thrives; JPD's kindness matches his beautiful '57 Bel Air.
Driven by Jurassic inspiration, the team transforms a modern house into a dinosaur haven.
Fiber optic lighting brings a scale-model replica of Hoddesdon, England, to life around three walls of a dining room.
Newlyweds update their home to reflect their fascination with the mob.
A couple with two grown children get the ultimate sports fans' home.
A love of Cajun culture leads to a house with a Mardi Gras theme.
Homeowners looking for something more decadent get the look of ancient Rome in their 1960s ranch-style home.
